spec: Spec maps every field the M1 model carries to Houdini attributes/groups/packed prims, with a complete honest round-trip table. spec: From M1 verification review (wf_0006d5e6-baf): (1) add_point/add_face validate and convert every input (vertices, normals, UV pairs incl. short pairs, flags, texture/material str) before the first append, so a bad call raises and leaves the LOD unchanged, like set_mesh. (2) A non-str texture/material is rejected at add_face/set_mesh, and write_p3d never leaks a raw TypeError (wrap as P3DError). (3) The lenient-raw exception in structure_errors accepts a kept RawTagg only while its name and data are unchanged since the read (or document that they must not be edited). Regression tests for each; suite passes on CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13.

spec:
Answer, with hython/command-line evidence on this machine (Houdini Indie 22.0.466; H21.0.596 is also installed if useful), the questions D11 needs to choose how nodes ship. Output: docs/design/packaging-spike.md, with a recommendation (HDA vs Python-SOP fallback vs hybrid). Each claim cites a check script under docs/design/evidence/packaging/ plus its output, or a docs page read via the docs tool.
1. Saving an HDA from this Indie install: what file/licence category results (.hda vs .hdalc; hou.licenseCategory, the asset's licence intrinsics)? What happens to a .hip / session (FX, Indie, Apprentice semantics per SideFX docs) that loads it?
2. Source build: can an HDA be expanded to a text directory and collapsed back with SideFX's command-line tool (hotl -t / -l, or the current equivalent), and does an HDA collapsed from source text by Indie hotl still carry the limited-commercial tag? Can a minimal Python SOP HDA be authored entirely from text (no GUI save) and load in hython?
3. Python-SOP fallback: a shelf script creates a Python SOP whose code calls into python/a3ob_houdini and adds spare parameters. Prove that it cooks in hython, survives save/load of a .hip, and record what breaks when the package code updates (parameter-layout drift). Also cover where node logic must live so that either wrapper works (logic in python/ modules, wrapper thin).
4. A SOP-level output node with a 'Save to Disk' button (D10 export): how is this done in each option (button callback -> python module)?
5. Is a Python SOP / Python-based HDA available and functional in Apprentice? Docs only; just state the answer.
Constraints: do not install anything into the user's Houdini prefs; work in temp dirs and remove test HDAs/hips afterwards. Do not cd outside your worktree (Aesir 0.18.0 safety notice): use absolute paths. No GUI interaction is required; the GUI session with the houdini MCP may be used read-only if helpful.

spec:
Write docs/design/ux-tools.md: the user-facing design of the A3OB Houdini tools, from owner decisions D10 (node/shelf split, workflow) and D11 (shipping pending the packaging spike), consistent with the M2 data-model spec (task #3 rev 3: D7/D8/D9).

(a) For each node in D10 (P3D Import, Extract LOD, Assemble LODs, LOD Properties, Proxy, Material assign, Mass, Validate, P3D Export): purpose, inputs/outputs, the parameter list with defaults (including the export options that default off: lowercase, relative paths, sort sections, sort LODs, auto-components, selection mask '* ^__*'), the spec attributes it reads and writes, and how errors and warnings surface.
(b) Each shelf tool in D10: what it does and what it creates.
(c) Three walkthroughs, step by step: edit an existing p3d (the character sample) and re-export; build a simple model from 'New P3D'; fix a validator error.

(e) Open UX questions for the owner, each with a recommendation.
Docs only; no code. Plain-language style per docs/practices.md comment-standard.

spec: 1. spec:
M3 step 1 (ux-tools.md section 9): shared node plumbing plus the P3D Import node. Normative inputs: docs/design/houdini-data-model.md (spec rev 3, sections 3-16, import outline section 16), docs/design/ux-tools.md sections 2, 3 and 5.1, docs/design/packaging-spike.md, D13, D14.
1. python/a3ob_houdini plumbing: one parameter table per node (the single source for its parameters); a cook wrapper that calls a frozen entry function and turns exceptions into a node error with the section 2 message form; message helpers (message, warning, error); string and group-name helpers (D-STR, encodeAttrib/decodeAttrib per spec section 7.3). No logic in the HDA files beyond calling entry functions.
2. a3ob_houdini importer: builds the P3D container geometry from an a3ob_core P3DModel following spec section 16 and every attribute table: points and loose points, polygons with the section 4.3 corner map, prim strings and flags, N and UVs, groups and a3ob_w_*/a3ob_fw_* weights (default 1.0), blobs (section 11.2, incl. MaskTagg/AnimationTagg), sharp edges, detail attributes (a3ob_lod_signature, a3ob_source_counts as int32[3], a3ob_tagg_order, ...), a3ob_lod_uid from lod_uid(source_key, lod_index) per section 3.5, proxies as packed prims (path/index inside and outside, section 13), one packed prim per LOD with name, a3ob_file_trailing. Axis map (x,y,-z) per D7/OQ-1.
3. P3D Import node: a text-authored Python-type SOP HDA in houdini/otls/<name>.hda/ folder form (D13: never GUI-saved), Tab menu under A3OB, parameters per ux-tools.md 5.1. Its DialogScript and other text sections are generated from the parameter table by a script in scripts/, and a test fails when the checked-in sources differ from the generated ones.
4. Tests (stdlib unittest; tests that need hou skip under CPython): for both fixtures, every attribute in the spec tables matches the M1 model (counts; exact float32 positions after the axis map; normals; UVs; face flags; textures and materials; selections and weights; mass; properties; signatures; proxy prims with path and index; TAGG order; blobs). lod_uid is stable across recooks and differs between two import nodes. With HOUDINI_PATH including <repo>/houdini (set only in the test child process), the HDA loads in hython and cooks sample_1_character.p3d with no errors and the expected LOD count. Import time for sample_1 (5.3 MB) is reported.
5. quick gate passes (CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13).
title: M3 step 1: node plumbing + P3D Import (text HDA)
